title: [Đề 10] Bộ Đề Thực Chiến B1 Số 06 — Chuẩn Đầu Ra ULIS (A Brief History of Apples)
description: Đề luyện thi thực chiến VNU Test Bậc 3 chuẩn hóa theo khung năng lực ngoại ngữ Bậc 3 (CEFR B1). Bài đọc thực tế: A Brief History of Apples (Part 2), Citisport in Newport (Part 3), Sarah Forbes: Getting a Good Night's Sleep (Part 4).

tasks.title: Part 1: Signs & Notices
tasks.instructions: There are 7 questions in this part. Choose the best answer (A, B, or C) that matches the meaning of each sign or notice.

questions.prompt:
Please don't eat ice creams here. They aren't good for our books! Please finish them outside before you come in.
Thanks.

Where might you see this?
questions.explanationVi: Biển báo viết: 'Please don't eat ice creams here. They aren't good for our books! Please finish them outside before you come in.' (Vui lòng không ăn kem ở đây vì kem có thể làm bẩn/hỏng sách của chúng tôi! Hãy ăn xong ở bên ngoài trước khi bước vào). Nơi lưu trữ nhiều sách cho mọi người đọc hoặc mượn chính là thư viện ('in a library'). Đáp án B đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: khu vực dã ngoại ngoài trời

questions.prompt:
FOUND
One school bag
Inside: one key and a phone
Contact Mrs Thompson if you think it might be yours.

Speak to Mrs Thompson if

options.text: you know where the bag is.

questions.explanationVi: Thông báo đồ nhặt được ('FOUND') ghi: Tìm thấy 1 cặp đi học bên trong có 1 chìa khóa và 1 điện thoại; hãy liên hệ với cô Thompson nếu bạn nghĩ đó là của mình. Như vậy bạn cần gặp cô Thompson nếu bạn vừa làm mất đồ ('you have lost something'). Đáp án B đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: đồ nhặt được (thông báo tìm chủ nhân)

questions.prompt:
Hi Linda. I have bought two tickets for the cinema tomorrow afternoon for me and Jim. But he can't come. Are you interested? Zeta

Zeta has written to

options.text: invite Linda to go and see a film.
ask Linda what films she's interested in.
tell Linda where to meet Jim tomorrow.

questions.explanationVi: Zeta nhắn cho Linda rằng cô đã mua 2 vé xem phim vào chiều mai cho cô và Jim, nhưng Jim không đi được nên hỏi Linda có muốn đi cùng không ('Are you interested?'). Mục đích tin nhắn là mời Linda đi xem phim ('invite Linda to go and see a film'). Đáp án A đúng.

questions.prompt:
From: Flora
To: Tony
Congratulations, Tony! I heard that you passed maths! Have a great birthday. And next time I write to you, you'll be 15!
Best wishes,
Flora

What has Tony just done?
questions.explanationVi: Flora chúc mừng Tony: 'Congratulations, Tony! I heard that you passed maths!' (Chúc mừng Tony! Mình nghe nói cậu đã thi đỗ môn Toán!). Thi đỗ môn Toán đồng nghĩa với việc vừa làm bài thi đạt kết quả tốt ('done well in an exam' - C). B sai vì sinh nhật của Tony sắp diễn ra chứ chưa qua.

questions.prompt:
NO EXIT
The door isn't working correctly.
Use door opposite to get to the science room.

options.text: Please go to the science room now.
You can't go out through this door.
The science laboratory is being used by other people today.

questions.explanationVi: Biển báo ghi: 'NO EXIT - The door isn't working correctly. Use door opposite to get to the science room.' (Không có lối ra - Cửa đang bị hỏng. Hãy dùng cửa đối diện để sang phòng khoa học). Điều này có nghĩa là bạn không thể đi ra ngoài qua cánh cửa này ('You can't go out through this door'). Đáp án B đúng.

questions.prompt:
Tom:
Thanks to all my guests! It's brilliant you could come. Hope you've made new friends. I'll add the pictures I took soon!

Tom is writing about

options.text: some people that he has just met.

questions.explanationVi: Tom gửi lời cảm ơn tới tất cả các vị khách ('Thanks to all my guests! It's brilliant you could come. Hope you've made new friends. I'll add the pictures I took soon!'). Đây là bài đăng cảm ơn sau một bữa tiệc mà cậu đã tổ chức ('a party that he had'). Đáp án A đúng.

questions.prompt:
To: Alice
From: Pete
I have three tickets for tomorrow's night concert but I won't be able to go. If you want them, come to my house by 4 p.m. The concert starts at 7.30.

What is Pete doing?

options.text: apologising to Alice for not going to the concert.
inviting Alice to go to the concert with him.
offering Alice concert tickets he has got.

questions.explanationVi: Pete viết rằng cậu có 3 vé xem hòa nhạc tối mai nhưng không đi được, và nói: 'If you want them, come to my house by 4 p.m.' (Nếu cậu muốn lấy vé thì hãy qua nhà mình trước 4 giờ chiều). Như vậy Pete đang ngỏ ý tặng/nhượng lại vé hòa nhạc cho Alice ('offering Alice concert tickets he has got'). Đáp án C đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: ngỏ ý tặng, đề nghị đưa cho

tasks.title: Part 2: Cloze Test
tasks.instructions: Read the text below and choose the best answer (A, B, or C) for each blank from 8 to 15.

passage.title: A Brief History of Apples
passage.text:
Do you always have a piece of fruit for your lunch? If you do, it's probably an apple! This is true particularly in places like western Europe, where apples have grown for hundreds of years. So it would be easy to (8) ________ that's where they came from originally.

In fact, though, the fruit we know today has been on an extraordinary (9) ________ over the centuries. Research suggests modern apples originally came all the way from Kazakhstan in Asia, and (10) ________ up in Europe partly because of people carrying goods along the famous Silk Road, from western Europe all the way to China in the east. This helped to spread apples in both (11) ________. People (12) ________ down their apples after they'd finished eating them, and the seeds entered the ground and (13) ________ new types of apple trees. Farmers were then (14) ________ to start developing a much (15) ________ range of apples.

questions.prompt: So it would be easy to (8) ________ that's where they came from originally.
questions.explanationVi: Cấu trúc 'it would be easy to imagine (that)...' (sẽ rất dễ hình dung/tưởng rằng đó là nơi táo xuất hiện đầu tiên). 'wonder' đi với 'if/whether/wh-' (tự hỏi), còn 'consider' thường dùng 'consider somebody/something (to be)...'. Đáp án C đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: ban đầu, có nguồn gốc từ

questions.prompt: In fact, though, the fruit we know today has been on an extraordinary (9) ________ over the centuries.
questions.explanationVi: Cụm từ cố định: 'be on a journey' ('has been on an extraordinary journey over the centuries' = đã trải qua một cuộc hành trình phi thường suốt nhiều thế kỷ). 'travel' là danh từ không đếm được nên không đi với mạo từ 'an', còn 'distance' là khoảng cách. Đáp án C đúng.

questions.prompt: ...modern apples originally came all the way from Kazakhstan in Asia, and (10) ________ up in Europe...
questions.explanationVi: Cụm động từ 'end up + giới từ chỉ nơi chốn' ('ended up in Europe' = cuối cùng đã có mặt / dừng chân tại châu Âu). 'reach' không đi với 'up', và 'set up' nghĩa là thành lập/lắp đặt. Đáp án B đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: rốt cuộc có mặt ở, kết thúc ở

questions.prompt: This helped to spread apples in both (11) ________.
questions.explanationVi: Cụm từ cố định: 'in both directions' (theo cả hai hướng/chiều Đông – Tây dọc theo Con đường Tơ lụa). Đáp án C đúng.

questions.prompt: People (12) ________ down their apples after they'd finished eating them...
questions.explanationVi: Cụm động từ 'throw down something' ('threw down their apples' = ném lõi quả táo xuống đất sau khi ăn xong). 'drop' không kết hợp với 'down' theo cách này khi cố tình vứt bỏ lõi quả, còn 'fall' là nội động từ. Đáp án A đúng.

questions.prompt: ...and the seeds entered the ground and (13) ________ new types of apple trees.
questions.explanationVi: Động từ 'produce' dùng cho cây cối/hạt giống ('produced new types of apple trees' = nảy mầm và tạo ra những giống cây táo mới). 'invent' là phát minh máy móc/kỹ thuật, 'build' là xây dựng công trình. Đáp án A đúng.

questions.prompt: Farmers were then (14) ________ to start developing a much...
questions.explanationVi: Cấu trúc 'be able to + V' ('Farmers were then able to start...' = Khi đó những người nông dân đã có thể bắt đầu lai tạo...). 'possible' không dùng với chủ ngữ chỉ người, còn 'capable' phải đi với giới từ 'of + V-ing'. Đáp án B đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: có thể, có khả năng làm gì

questions.prompt: ...start developing a much (15) ________ range of apples.
questions.explanationVi: Cụm từ cố định (collocation): 'a broader / wider range of...' (một sự đa dạng phong phú/rộng lớn hơn nhiều về các giống táo). 'longer' (dài hơn) và 'deeper' (sâu hơn) không đi với 'range'. Đáp án C đúng.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: một phạm vi/chủng loại rộng lớn, đa dạng

tasks.title: Part 3: True / False
tasks.instructions: Read the text below and decide whether the statements from 16 to 20 are True or False. Choose A for True and B for False.

passage.title: Citisport in Newport
passage.text:
We at Citisport aim to improve sports training and facilities in Newport, giving you more opportunity to try both new and traditional sports.

As well as running our own courses, Citisport can also provide sports advisers and qualified coaches for youth groups, schools and colleges in and around Newport. And if you can't find the sport you want to take up, let us know and we'll try to find you a local club which will help you.

Golf
We are pleased to be able to offer lessons at Kingsway Golf Centre just outside Newport. These are run by experienced golf professionals, and are held on an all-weather practice area. The Centre also has Pay and Play golf facilities so you can continue to play and make progress after the lessons have finished. These facilities are available to all players, whether or not they are members of the Centre.
The adult lessons are open to anyone aged 13 and over, and are suitable for all levels from beginners upwards. These take place on Wednesdays from 3.00 to 4.00 pm over a period of six weeks. Children's lessons for 7-12 year olds are held from 2.00 to 3.00 pm on Saturdays during term time.

Tennis
The Citisport tennis courses provide an opportunity for local people to develop their skills on the brand new indoor tennis court at Newport Leisure Centre. All equipment can be provided, but please feel free to use your own racket if you prefer. Our Starter course is held on Mondays from 7.00 to 8.00 pm, and is for beginners of 12 years and over. Our Improver course, which takes place on Tuesdays from 8.00 to 9.00 pm, is for players with some experience.

Football for girls
By popular request, Citisport is holding another one-day, girls-only football course. This aims to give local girls, whether new or experienced players, the chance to learn essential skills and develop more advanced ones. One of Newport City Football Club's players will come along to take part in a question and answer session during the day. The course fee of £30 includes morning and afternoon refreshments. Please bring a packed lunch. The course will take place on Saturday, 9th November from 9.00 to 5.00 pm, and is open to all girls aged 10-14 years living in the Newport area.

Gymnastics
This course is for beginners aged 8-14 and will provide an introduction to basic skills. There is a maximum of six pupils per coach in each class. At the end of the course there is a demonstration for friends and family of all the skills learnt there. Thursdays, 6.00 to 7.00 pm

questions.prompt: Citisport can send their own instructors to schools in the area.
questions.explanationVi: Đoạn 2 nêu rõ: 'As well as running our own courses, Citisport can also provide sports advisers and qualified coaches for youth groups, schools and colleges in and around Newport'. Citisport có thể cử các huấn luyện viên ('qualified coaches' = 'instructors') tới các trường học trong khu vực. Đáp án A (True).

vocabularyNotes.meaning: huấn luyện viên có bằng cấp chuyên môn
bắt đầu tập luyện một môn thể thao

questions.prompt: The golf lessons can take place even in bad weather.
questions.explanationVi: Mục Golf viết: 'These are run by experienced golf professionals, and are held on an all-weather practice area' (được tổ chức tại khu vực tập luyện thích ứng mọi điều kiện thời tiết 'all-weather'). Vì vậy lớp học vẫn diễn ra ngay cả khi thời tiết xấu. Đáp án A (True).

vocabularyNotes.meaning: dùng được trong mọi điều kiện thời tiết

questions.prompt: Teenagers can attend golf lessons on Wednesday afternoons.
questions.explanationVi: Mục Golf ghi: 'The adult lessons are open to anyone aged 13 and over... These take place on Wednesdays from 3.00 to 4.00 pm'. Thanh thiếu niên ('teenagers', từ 13 đến 19 tuổi) hoàn toàn đủ điều kiện tham gia lớp học chiều thứ Tư này. Đáp án A (True).

vocabularyNotes.meaning: từ trình độ sơ cấp mới bắt đầu trở lên

questions.prompt: The football course is for girls of all levels of ability.
questions.explanationVi: Mục Football for girls viết: 'This aims to give local girls, whether new or experienced players, the chance to learn essential skills and develop more advanced ones' (Dành cho cả người mới lẫn người đã có kinh nghiệm). Tức là phù hợp cho mọi trình độ năng lực. Đáp án A (True).

vocabularyNotes.meaning: theo yêu cầu của đông đảo mọi người

questions.prompt: A midday meal is included in the price of the girls' football course.
questions.explanationVi: Mục Football for girls nêu rõ: 'The course fee of £30 includes morning and afternoon refreshments. Please bring a packed lunch' (Học phí 30 bảng chỉ bao gồm đồ ăn nhẹ buổi sáng và chiều; học viên phải tự mang theo bữa trưa đóng hộp). Như vậy bữa trưa ('midday meal') KHÔNG nằm trong học phí. Đáp án B (False).

vocabularyNotes.meaning: đồ ăn thức uống giải khát nhẹ
bữa trưa đóng hộp mang theo

tasks.title: Part 4: Reading Comprehension
tasks.instructions: Read the following passage and choose the best answer (A, B, or C) for each question from 21 to 25.

passage.title: Sarah Forbes: Getting a Good Night's Sleep
passage.text:
I can't remember when I started to have problems sleeping. As a student I seemed to spend half of my life sleeping. But after my graduation I found myself spending hours lying awake until the early hours of the morning. After a few weeks of this I decided to do something about it. I often went to bed at different times; perhaps there was a programme on TV I wanted to watch, or I'd be watching videos on my phone. So I tried going to bed at the same time each night. This took a while to get used to but slowly I found myself getting into a regular routine.

I also took the advice of a friend and made sure I did things to help me relax before I went to bed. I'd start by writing a list of things I needed to do the next day so I wouldn't end up thinking about them during the night. I got into the habit of having a nice warm bath before bedtime and then did some relaxation exercises like meditation. Reading also seemed to work, but not in the way I expected. I would sometimes just fall asleep in the middle of a chapter!

I also found some suggestions online about how to make your bedroom sleep-friendly. I used to have very thin curtains that let the light from outside shine through, so I changed these for thicker ones. I also removed all technology from the room like the TV and the laptop as these are not supposed to help you sleep, even if they are switched off. And of course I left the mobile phone downstairs!

And the result? I'm pleased to say it's worked. Of course, there are some nights where I find it difficult to go to sleep but mostly I'm getting a good seven hours' sleep a night. I started to make a note of my sleep patterns and this is also useful as it helps show things that were making me lie awake, like problems at work. So, I have to say it has been a very successful experiment.

questions.prompt: When did Sarah's sleeping problems begin?
questions.explanationVi: Trong đoạn 1, Sarah kể: 'As a student I seemed to spend half of my life sleeping. But after my graduation I found myself spending hours lying awake until the early hours of the morning.' Chứng mất ngủ của cô bắt đầu sau khi cô tốt nghiệp đại học ('after my graduation' = 'after she finished at university' - B).

vocabularyNotes.meaning: lễ tốt nghiệp / việc tốt nghiệp đại học
nằm trằn trọc không ngủ được

questions.prompt: Writing a list of jobs to be done

options.text: meant Sarah worked harder the next day.
was the first thing Sarah did at bedtime.

questions.explanationVi: Trong đoạn 2, khi nói về các việc làm trước giờ đi ngủ, Sarah viết: 'I'd start by writing a list of things I needed to do the next day so I wouldn't end up thinking about them during the night.' Cụm 'I'd start by...' chứng tỏ việc viết danh sách công việc cần làm là việc đầu tiên cô thực hiện trước khi đi ngủ (C).

questions.prompt: What does Sarah say was the problem with her bedroom?

options.text: She often left her laptop switched on.

questions.explanationVi: Trong đoạn 3, Sarah giải thích: 'I used to have very thin curtains that let the light from outside shine through, so I changed these for thicker ones.' Rèm cửa cũ quá mỏng khiến ánh sáng bên ngoài chiếu xuyên vào làm phòng ngủ quá sáng ('It was too bright' - C).

questions.prompt: Sarah says that now

options.text: she never finds it difficult sleeping.
she keeps a record of how well she sleeps.
she never thinks about work at night.

questions.explanationVi: Trong đoạn 4, Sarah nói: 'I started to make a note of my sleep patterns and this is also useful as it helps show things that were making me lie awake, like problems at work.' Cụm 'make a note of my sleep patterns' đồng nghĩa với 'keeps a record of how well she sleeps' (ghi chép lại theo dõi chất lượng giấc ngủ - B). A sai vì vẫn có vài đêm cô khó ngủ ('some nights where I find it difficult').

vocabularyNotes.meaning: ghi chép lại để theo dõi
chu kỳ / thói quen giấc ngủ

questions.prompt: What would be a good introduction to this article?

options.text: Our sleep expert Sarah Forbes explains how you can make sure you get a good night's sleep.
Sarah Forbes has not slept well for years. She told us how it affects her work.
Sarah Forbes suddenly found herself having trouble getting to sleep. But she took control of the situation.

questions.explanationVi: Toàn bài là lời chia sẻ của Sarah (một người bình thường chứ không phải chuyên gia giấc ngủ - loại A) về việc cô bất ngờ bị mất ngủ sau khi tốt nghiệp và sau vài tuần đã chủ động tìm giải pháp khắc phục thành công ('took control of the situation' - C). B sai vì cô chỉ mới mất ngủ vài tuần trước khi bắt tay vào thay đổi.

vocabularyNotes.meaning: kiểm soát, làm chủ tình hình

tasks.title: Part 1: Short Recordings
tasks.instructions: There are 7 questions in this part. For each question, you will listen to one short recording TWICE. Choose the right answer (A, B, or C).
tasks.transcript:
[Recording 1]:
Woman: What time are we meeting Jane?
Man: At half past seven outside the restaurant.
Woman: I told her to wait inside, at a table.
Man: I know, but she said she'd prefer to meet us outside.

[Recording 2]:
Girl: It's Chris's birthday on Friday. What shall we get him?
Boy: Mmm, it's difficult. Tapes? CDs? But he's already got a lot of those ...
Girl: We could get him something to wear. No, let's get him a book on sport – he's really keen on that.
Boy: Why not?

[Recording 3]:
Man: So, could you describe Mr Jones for me please, madam?
Woman: Well, he's about 40 years old, bald, with a moustache. He's got large ears and he wears glasses.

[Recording 4]:
Woman: Where are you going to plant the tree? By the front door?
Man: No, that would be silly. It'll grow too big. I'm going to put it at the back of the garage. When it's grown, it'll give us some shade in the summer.
Woman: I thought it would be better right at the other end of the lawn.
Man: Oh, no.

[Recording 5]:
Man: Shall I get some fruit for the picnic?
Woman: Yes, can you get some oranges and bananas?
Man: I'm not very keen on oranges. How about grapes instead?
Woman: They're so expensive at the moment. Just get the bananas.

[Recording 6]:
Woman: Look, Gary's sent us a postcard of his hotel, and he's put a cross to show us his window!
Man: Ah, right in the middle.
Woman: Yes, he says he wanted a room on the top floor, but the only room available was on the floor below that.

[Recording 7]:
Woman: Good morning, sir, how can I help you?
Man: Well, I'd like to hire a car, please. Something fast and comfortable, with enough room for four adults and a child.

questions.prompt: When and where are they meeting?

options.text: At 7:30 inside the restaurant at a table

questions.transcript:
Woman: What time are we meeting Jane?
Man: At half past seven outside the restaurant.
Woman: I told her to wait inside, at a table.
Man: I know, but she said she'd prefer to meet us outside.
questions.explanationVi: Người đàn ông nói: 'At half past seven outside the restaurant.' Người phụ nữ bảo đã dặn Jane đợi ở bàn bên trong, nhưng người đàn ông giải thích: 'I know, but she said she'd prefer to meet us outside.' Như vậy họ sẽ gặp Jane lúc 7:30 ở bên ngoài nhà hàng (C).

questions.prompt: What will Chris get for his birthday?
questions.transcript:
Girl: It's Chris's birthday on Friday. What shall we get him?
Boy: Mmm, it's difficult. Tapes? CDs? But he's already got a lot of those ...
Girl: We could get him something to wear. No, let's get him a book on sport – he's really keen on that.
Boy: Why not?
questions.explanationVi: Hai người bạn bàn mua quà sinh nhật cho Chris: cậu bé loại trừ băng đĩa nhạc ('Tapes? CDs? But he's already got a lot of those'), cô gái thoáng nghĩ tới quần áo rồi quyết định: 'No, let's get him a book on sport – he's really keen on that' và cậu bé đồng ý ('Why not?'). Vậy Chris sẽ nhận được một cuốn sách về thể thao (C).

questions.prompt: What does Mr Jones look like?

options.text: A man with thick hair, a moustache, and glasses
A bald man with a beard and no glasses
A bald man with a moustache, large ears, and glasses

questions.transcript:

Woman: Well, he's about 40 years old, bald, with a moustache. He's got large ears and he wears glasses.

questions.prompt: Where is he going to plant the tree?

options.text: At the back of the garage
By the front door of the house
At the other end of the lawn

questions.transcript:

tasks.title: Part 2: Short Conversations
tasks.instructions: There are 7 questions in this part. For each question, you will listen to one conversation TWICE. Choose the right answer (A, B, or C).
tasks.transcript:
[Conversation 8]:
Boy: That class was fun. I like working in groups like that.
Girl: I guess it means there are five of you to set up the experiment, so you can get it done in half the time. How much I enjoy it, though, depends very much on who I'm asked to work with. I usually don't get along so well with at least one of the others, which kind of spoils things.
Boy: I suppose it does.
Girl: But at least you can solve problems and work out what's happening better if there are five minds thinking about it.

[Conversation 9]:
Boy: That was a great museum.
Girl: If I went again, though, I'd suggest not bothering with that room with those old pots.
Boy: I liked them - they really helped me to imagine what life was like back then. You seemed to enjoy the shop though - you were in there for ages.
Girl: I wish I'd taken more money.
Boy: It gives us a good reason to come back - there was this amazing puzzle of some ancient ruins I really wanted.
Girl: It was a long way to come to see a museum of that size, though.
Boy: Yes, I imagined it'd be much bigger.

[Conversation 10]:
Boy: I really enjoyed that. I came so close to getting the ball in the net a few times, too.
Girl: If you all play as well as that in every game, you should start actually beating some of the other teams.
Boy: I hope so. We've all trained really hard this season, and our new coach has made a big difference. I think I probably played better than usual because Mum and Dad could both get here for once. I'm always really cheerful when they do.
Girl: Well I'm sure they enjoyed it as much as I did.
Boy: I hope so.

[Conversation 11]:
Girl: What did you think of that poem we read in the literature class?
Boy: It always takes me a while to work out what old poems like that are about, but that's what I like about them.
Girl: Me too. It'd be a shame if you understood everything after you'd only read it once.
Boy: I can't help wondering why the poet made it so long, though.
Girl: I'm sure it'd be possible to say the same thing in half as many words.
Boy: It would, and without changing the message of what he wants to say.
Girl: Absolutely!

[Conversation 12]:
Boy: So what do you think of my essay?
Girl: I think it's OK. The teacher will definitely be surprised by what you chose to write about, but in a good way - it's certainly original.
Boy: So you think it's ready to hand in then?
Girl: If I were you, I'd look at the way it's written. You've included plenty of information about the topic and some good examples to support what you're saying, but it's written a bit like a list at the moment. You need to see if you can get it to flow more, so it sounds more natural.
Boy: I'll try!

[Conversation 13]:
Boy: You know that video game you lent me?
Girl: Yes, have you got it with you?
Boy: I haven't actually. I put it in my bag last night to bring to school today, but I think my brother saw it and probably wanted to play it, too. I think he took it out and it'll be in his bedroom somewhere now.
Girl: Oh dear!
Boy: He didn't know I said I'd give it back to you today. I'm sure he'd be extremely grateful if we could keep it for a couple of extra days.
Girl: That's OK, no problem.

tasks.title: Part 3: Extended Conversation (True / False)
tasks.instructions: You will hear a conversation between a girl, Kate, and a boy, George. Listen TWICE and decide if each sentence from 15 to 20 is Correct (True) or Incorrect (False). Choose A for True and B for False.
tasks.transcript:
Kate: I don't remember much of that lecture. The doctor gave me this medicine for my cough, but I don't like it – it seems to make me awfully sleepy and I can't follow my lectures.
George: Well, if you don't take it, none of us will be able to follow our lectures – all we'll hear is you coughing!
Kate: Oh dear, do you think I'll annoy everybody?
George: Yes. You could study at home for a couple of days – you know, have some time off until it gets better.
Kate: Oh I couldn't do that! I'd miss too much and I get really uncomfortable when I have a lot of catching up to do. Last year I missed a whole week when I fell off my bike and had that enormous bandage on my hand. It took me ages to do all the work when I came back.
George: Oh, you worry too much. You can work at home. Just get Mr Gray to tell you which parts of the coursebook we'll be covering and read it yourself at home. All he does is go through the book anyway – you might as well do it yourself.
Kate: Oh, that's a bit unfair! I think Mr Gray's really nice. He's always willing to stay behind after class if you don't understand something.
George: Being 'really nice' and never in a hurry doesn't make him a good lecturer. Anyway I think you should look after your health first – and ours! If we sit in that small, hot room with you for the next three days, we'll all have your cough by the end of it.
Kate: Mmm, perhaps you're right. I don't care about myself, but I wouldn't like other people to blame me for their illnesses. I have got a bit of a temperature now, too – so maybe I'll go and see Mr Gray after lunch and tell him I won't be at this afternoon's lecture.
George: Or the next two ... come on, you've got to get better.
Kate: I suppose you're right.
George: Then we can all go out as we planned at the weekend.
Kate: OK then, I don't want to miss that ... and I do feel ill ...

writingPrompts.sampleAnswer: We are happy to invite all staff members to take part in our annual Company Charity Run on Sunday, October 18th. topicChoices.topic: Write a paragraph about the benefits of doing regular physical exercise.

Making muscles and bones stronger through daily sports

writingPrompts.sampleAnswer: In my opinion, doing regular exercise brings many important benefits to both our body and our mind. First of all, exercising three or four times a week helps us stay fit, control our weight, and prevent common illnesses such as heart disease. For example, simple activities like morning jogging, swimming, or playing badminton make our muscles and bones much stronger. Secondly, physical exercise is a great way to reduce stress after a long day at school or work because it helps us sleep better at night. In conclusion, everyone should spend at least thirty minutes exercising every day to enjoy a healthy and happy life.
